title: Password-based cipher without an IV via crypto.createDecipher (javascript) — review required
description: The javascript call crypto.createDecipher derives a key from a passphrase (an OpenSSL EVP_BytesToKey style KDF) and decrypts with a legacy algorithm without an explicit IV. The same passphrase therefore yields the same keystream, and the key stretching is far too cheap. Use an authenticated cipher with crypto.createDecipheriv and a managed key.
remediation: Move to an authenticated cipher with an explicit IV (crypto.createDecipheriv) and a real KDF such as scrypt or Argon2.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the crypto.createDecipher call; algorithm strength and key management are reviewed separately.
